loadout.attribute: AFTER WEAPON CRAFTING: Dmg based - Agility (until 1900-1950 slashing pen), then rest into STR. Capped pen+survivability - Agility (until 1900-1950 slashing), then rest either Armor or Toughness. Survivability - Toughness/Armor: "find which direction you want to take depending on how often you feel you're getting oneshot vs times where you're getting overwhelmed by multiple damages at once - Toughness I think it's way more viable now due to the Ultimate changes and runes." (General Hero Guide's cross-class blanket table instead says Full HP/Armor for Nodachi; denetax.fr corroborates this branching shape instead: "Agility + Strength (DPS) or Agility + Armor (Mix) or Full Armor") - BirdOfQin
loadout.genderNote: OP believes no real difference beyond female's minimal hitbox changes and Bloodthirsty travel distance (male had "a little bit more" per OP's recollection, "dont take it for granted"). Not corroborated elsewhere - wiki doesn't mention gender for this class at all.

armorSets.name: Carnifex's Armour

spells.fillerNotes: 4th slot is one of Samurai's March/Fearless & Steadfast (per OP's own "Recommended loadout" line). OP's separate "Different Playstyles" framing instead runs Fearless & Steadfast, Tiger's Claw, Bloodthirsty (PvP-oriented) or Samurai's March (PvUnits-oriented), plus Dragon's Leap (PvP/E) or Avalanche (PvE) - not fully reconciled with the Recommended loadout line. Wiki calls Bloodthirsty "the near mandatory skill for nodachi users," and denetax.fr's two build variants both run Fearless & Steadfast + Tiger's Claw + Bloodthirsty + Dragon's Leap/Avalanche, converging with the wiki rather than Amya's separate Recommended-loadout line. - BirdOfQin

techniques.name: Animation canceling
steps: Block or roll
the animation cancels
reposition or follow up
Training room: try roll-canceling, dismount-canceling and blocking on every skill to learn which are cancelable.
techniques.rhythm: Amya: EVERY CLASS CAN DO IT! - Blocking is the primary cancel; roll canceling interrupts full spells, dismounts, and creates movement otherwise impossible. Costs extra stamina.

techniques.name: Active blocking
steps: Hold block between actions
watch your block VALUE
it can be BROKEN and stagger you
techniques.rhythm: Don't get "Block checked" - Being an active blocker prevents undesired skills landing on you.

techniques.name: Horse-whistle CC immunity
steps: Time the whistle on the enemy CC
summon animation = locked state
you take damage but no CC
techniques.rhythm: bugs out with PIN/LOCK skills, so care

techniques.name: Walk into braced units
steps: Walk (don't sprint) into their minimal range
destroy them from the inside
techniques.rhythm: brace damage scales with your speed towards them - For braced units like Forte, Halberds, Phalanx - niche: enemy hero outnumbered, unaware or afk.

techniques.name: Anti-cavalry normal-attack interrupt
steps: Walk near or into the path of charging cavalry
time the 4-hit normal-attack combo
3rd/4th hits land on the charging unit

techniques.name: Delayed-combo timing
steps: Normal attacks
can be delayed slightly
without dropping the combo
techniques.rhythm: Most valuable on Black Sun Anchorite's Armour, whose 4pc grants CC immunity for the duration of Combo Strikes.

gameplay.text: Nodachi users have plenty of tools to stay in a fight, including several control effect removal skills and their unique lifesteal capabilities, but do not have strong mobility and are vulnerable to being locked down by other weapon classes capable of inflicting heavy amounts of control effects.

roleLabel: The nodachi is a large two-handed sword that excels at cutting down lightly protected units.

positioning.intro: Where to be during a fight:

bullets.text: Fight to the sides or behind your own units, using Tiger's Claw/Avalanche/Fearless & Steadfast from that position rather than out in the open.
position against light infantry and ranged blobs, not shielded formations - Dragon's Leap is your only unblockable answer if you do end up vs shields.
Samurai's March singles out tightly packed unit blobs - Onna-musha, Shieldmaidens (wiki).
don't dive it in front of pike units (Amya); consistent with the wiki's broader duel hard-counter list also naming Pike.
Only commit Avalanche once already in Bloodbath or Fearless & Steadfast's CC-immune window - diving unstacked against a hero or shielded/high-burst units is a liability ("or you're a goner").
Bloodthirsty is "the near mandatory skill for nodachi users" - mobility, a control effect, and a control-effect removal in one low-cooldown package (wiki).

Tiger's Claw is the highest-damaging non-paragon skill and has a wide pushback, "an extremely popular choice." Fearless & Steadfast is prized for its low-cooldown CC removal/immunity, "a great option for additional safety." Samurai's March chains control on heroes and hits tightly packed units hard. Monstrous Blade's extreme lifesteal makes it "an excellent buff skill," complicated only by its long cooldown.

"It's also perfectly viable to not use either paragon skill at all and instead use 4 basic skills" (wiki). Avalanche is specifically called out as "fairly unpopular amongst nodachi users" because it's easy for heroes to roll out of and it "suffers heavily against shielded or high burst damage units."
Normal attacks hit unusually hard on this class: "it's encouraged to use the normal attack combo when fighting, especially the 3rd and 4th attack hits" (wiki).
The dismount attack is high-damage with a knockdown, but has a long wind-up before the swing; it can be aimed right up until the moment it fires.
slashing damage and slashing armour penetration "first and foremost" (wiki), matching the weapon_stats NEED line.
even lighter-armoured heroes can emergency-swap to a nodachi at supply to help hold a point a few seconds longer; a units-empty Nodachi still blocks enemy supply by simply standing on it.
Active blocking specifically denies Nodachi's own Bloodthirsty CC when playing against one; the same logic applies in reverse when you're the Nodachi player reading an opponent's block stance.

bullets.lead: Epic Schematic isn't a rush target:
bullets.text: "wouldn't focus straight on the Epic set - better to focus on the weapon first and go until you have a set with Carnifex."

weapon reforge (slashing dmg/pen) first, then Carnifex's Armour (rare, standard, attainable via crafting or Matched Battles) as the mid-point, then Black Sun Anchorite's Armour (epic) for players committing to the class long term.

statSpreads.spread: Damage-based (Agility until 1900-1950 slashing pen, then Strength) or capped-pen/survivability (Agility until 1900-1950 slashing pen, then Armor or Toughness)
Survivability branch (Toughness/Armor) once the Agility pen target (1900-1950 slashing pen) is hit

runesNote: runes rotate every season - names change, effects re-issue under new names

combos.name: Blood Oath reset
steps: Blood Oath
clears cooldown on Tiger's Claw, Fearless & Steadfast, Samurai's March, Bloodthirsty + 9s dmg buff
combos.note: "can be strong in the right situations, such as for chaining control effects on heroes."

combos.name: Bloodthirsty-into-Tiger's-Claw opener
steps: Bloodthirsty (closes distance, knockdown, clears Dazed/Knocked Down, +1 Bloodlust)
Tiger's Claw (+2 Bloodlust, 600-900 HP healing per swing)

combos.name: Avalanche stacking dive
steps: already in Bloodbath or Fearless & Steadfast's CC-immune window
dive Avalanche into a blob of units
combos.note: nets up to 6 Bloodlust stacks and 3% HP healing per hit in one cast; mistimed against a hero or shielded/high-burst units it's a liability ("or you're a goner").

combos.name: Dragon's Leap as disruption/escape
steps: charge 2+ seconds
knockdown/send-flying, unblockable, -50% damage taken while charging
combos.note: wiki: "excellent for disrupting enemy formations and can also be used as an escape tool"; Amya: don't send it in front of pike units.

combos.name: Samurai's March CC-chain / anti-blob
steps: press twice
2nd hit sends soldiers flying, knocks back heroes
combos.note: the OP calls the 2nd hit's CC "very good vs units"; the wiki adds it's effective against tightly packed units specifically, naming Onna-musha and Shieldmaidens.

items.effect: When life-stealing, 30% of the healing effect is converted into damage dealt to enemies. Cost: 3 Rune Power.

items.name: Martial Valor
items.effect: [Dragon's Leap] does not require charging to gain the damage and Knockup effects of a 2-second charge, and it resets the cooldown of all skills except the Ultimate. Hitting an enemy with a skill grants [Heroic Blessing]; each stack increases damage by 2% and life-steal by 1.5%. Stacks up to 15 times for 6 seconds. When the duration ends, stacks are reduced by 3. Cost: 3 Rune Power.

runes.effect: Damage taken from Units is reduced by 20%. When Health falls below 50%, damage taken from Units is additionally reduced by 10%.

runes.name: Tempered Armor
runes.effect: Damage taken from Units is reduced by 20%. Upon taking damage from Units, damage taken from Units is additionally reduced by 15% for 5 seconds (triggers once every 15 seconds).

runes.name: Avalon's Blessing
runes.effect: Restores 2% of max Health per second while inside an allied Supply Point.

runes.name: Divine Right
runes.effect: When casting a non-ranged [Damage] skill, all defence values are increased by 25% for 8 seconds. (14/05/2026 rework, news/1767)

runes.name: Hwarang Resolve
runes.effect: Damage taken is reduced by 10%; while in Knockback, Knockdown, Knockup, and Concussed states, damage taken is additionally reduced by 5% (buffed to 25% by the 14/05/2026 patch, news/1767; the Chaos re-issue Art of Stillness is back to 5%).

runes.name: Dragonblood Bath
runes.effect: All defences are increased by 3.5%. When Health is below 50%, all defences are increased by an additional 2.5% for 5 seconds (triggers once every 30 seconds).

runes.name: Martyr's Glory
runes.effect: Increases maximum Health by 5%; upon death, nearby allies instantly recover 10% of their maximum Health.

items.note: Take faster bandage then it's full preference

runes.effect: Movement speed is increased by 6%. Upon death, the movement speed of surrounding allies is increased by 8% for 10 seconds.
